messages:
nisha_support: FYI - multiple customers reporting sudden stream timeouts and 502/504s starting ~08:02 UTC. Support ticket IDs 9871, 9872, 9873. Swarming? :eyes:
lee_oncall: I'm seeing a spike in ingestion errors on the ap-south gateway, p50->p99 jump around 08:01. Lots of 502s from proxy->runtime.
tom_eng: grabbing logs. initial look: a lot of `auth.kms refresh` failures and connection resets on the client keepalives. Could be correlated.
sara_ops: rolling deploy of autoscaler config went out at 07:58 - lowered max ephemeral workers to 60% to conserve capacity during E2E tests.
mike_reliability: that could explain worker exhaustion if a tenant storm arrived. Do we have tenant concurrency metrics?
lee_oncall: attaching quick tail from proxy (snippet):
```
[08:01:02] proxy: upstream reset by peer id=10 err=ECONNRESET
[08:01:03] auth: kms refresh failed code=429 msg="rate limited"
[08:01:04] proxy: conn_pool exhausted tenant=acme-inc waiting=24
[08:01:05] runtime: model stream abort code=504
```
lee_oncall: primary pain appears to be auth refresh hitting KMS rate limits -> proxy backpressure -> conn_pool exhaustion -> 502/504s to clients.
nisha_support: customers say errors started after a big batch ingest from one client around 07:59. we throttled that customer from support, but errors persisted for other tenants.
tom_eng: mitigation idea: temporarily enable tenant-level circuit breaker + increase proxy worker threads and bump conn pool size. Also roll back the autoscaler change.
sara_ops: rolling back autoscaler now to previous config (started). ETA 90s.
incident_bot: deploy/event: autoscaler.rollback by sara_ops at 08:03:12 UTC 
mike_reliability: oncall note: while rollback running, we should add a temporary ingress token-bucket (per-tenant) to limit new streaming connections from high-volume clients. I can flip that gate.
lee_oncall: please do. Also enable immediate fallback route to smaller model for long streaming requests to reduce runtime pressure.
sara_ops: autoscaler rollback complete at 08:04:45 - worker pool back to normal.
mike_reliability: enabled per-tenant token bucket at 08:05:10 (burst=50, refill=10/s) for tenants with >80 concurrent streams.
tom_eng: activated fallback routing at 08:05:40 for streaming endpoints: requests >60s or >200 tokens route to small-llama-7b-quant.
nisha_support: started proactive customer comms templates for affected customers, sent initial update to ACME, DeltaApps, and BetaLabs at 08:06.
lee_oncall: after mitigations, 502/504 rate dropped ~85% by 08:08. still seeing isolated auth.kms 429s but no widespread client impact.
mike_reliability: scoreboard: rollback + token-bucket + fallback reduced pressure. Next: identify root cause of KMS rate spikes and why single tenant caused cross-tenant impact.
tom_eng: quick reproduction plan: simulate 1k concurrent streaming connections with frequent token refreshes (every 60s) to ap-south gateway and watch KMS refresh QPS and proxy conn_pool. Need a short load test run.
sara_ops: can run a controlled blast in staging with mirrored infra. I'll schedule immediate test on perf-staging.
lee_oncall: action items (short-term):
- deploy per-tenant token-bucket by default with conservative defaults (mike)
- revert autoscaler change permanently until we validate (sara)
- add runtime fallback route for streaming > threshold (tom)
- notify top customers about mitigation/fallback and offer extended logs (nisha)
lee_oncall: longer term (postmortem items):
- instrument KMS refresh queue and add alert for sustained 429s (mike)
- add tenant isolation test in perf-suite to simulate refresh storms (tom)
- update runbook: "ingress-throttle->kms-429" with clear mitigation steps + commands (lee)
- review autoscaler gating + canary strategy (sara)
incident_bot: ticket created: INC-2026 (root cause investigation) assigned to mike_reliability, tom_eng, due 3 days.
mike_reliability: immediate telemetry gaps: we don't have p99 concurrent-streams per-tenant historically at retention >7d. need dashboard.
tom_eng: adding metrics: `tenant.conn_count.p99`, `proxy.conn_pool_waits`, `kms.refresh_429_rate` to infra dashboard. Will PR by EOD.
sara_ops: perf-staging blast scheduled at 09:15 UTC, test plan: 1k concurrent streams, refresh interval 60s, 30m run. I'll post results.
nisha_support: customers accepted temporary fallback; two asked for SLA credits. logging support: collect trace ids and request ids to link to tickets.
lee_oncall: final status: incident mitigated at 08:10, partial residuals cleared by 08:30. creating post-incident doc and assigning owners. Good job. :thumbsup:
tom_eng: sample commands we used for quick mitigation (for runbook):
```
# enable token-bucket gate
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/feature-gates" -d '{"gate":"per_tenant_token_bucket","enable":true,"config":{"burst":50,"rate":10}}'

# rollback autoscaler
kubectl rollout undo deployment/autoscaler -n infra
```
lee_oncall: leaving a note to engage KMS vendor on rate-limit behavior and consider client-side jitter on refresh.
mike_reliability: postmortem start: collect logs, timeline, perf-staging reproduction results, and draft mitigations doc. I'll own postmortem draft.
nisha_support: I'll coordinate customer comms follow-up once postmortem is ready.
incident_bot: reminder scheduled: postmortem draft due in 72h.
lee_oncall: closing thread here; will link to postmortem doc when ready.
